props.doc:
Read the engine definition into the editor model.

The engine links nodes by named FIELDS (next, on_error, on_approve). The
editor wants explicit edges so it can draw and hit-test them. This is the
only place that difference exists, and its inverse is toDefinition - the two
are tested against each other by a round-trip assertion.

props.doc:
The checks worth doing in the browser, as you draw.

Deliberately a SUBSET of the server validator and never a replacement for it:
publish always re-runs the full check server-side. The point of doing it here
is that an unreachable node should be visible the moment you create it, not
twenty minutes later when you press Publish.

props.doc:
Undo/redo by snapshot.

Snapshots rather than inverse operations: a playbook graph is small (tens of
nodes), and an undo that is a structural copy cannot drift from the thing it
is undoing. Command-pattern undo is the right answer at a hundred times this
size and the wrong answer here.
props.name: createHistory
